source.database_note: dev database file hash is environment-specific; input_slice_sha256 pins selected PBP rows

scope.queried_week_filter: season=2022 AND week IN (1,2,3,4,5) AND play_type IS NOT NULL

model.name: PBP-only hierarchical conditional median
model.prediction_target: same-quarter current play game_seconds_remaining minus next PBP play game_seconds_remaining
model.folding: leave-one-week-out; week 5 trains on weeks 1-4 only

evaluation.interpretation: PBP-only retrospective clock-delta estimate; not a pre-snap forecast, physical play duration, or stoppage adjudication.

unresolvable_policy.null_rule: unresolvable values have null value and retain a rule; no fallback or proxy is substituted
unresolvable_policy.live_duration: unresolvable for every row without tracking terminal timestamps
unresolvable_policy.between_play_dead_time: unresolvable for every row because PBP delta cannot be decomposed without live duration
unresolvable_policy.out_of_bounds_and_timeout: unresolvable from nfl_pbp alone; do not copy nflverse flags or tracking labels
unresolvable_policy.penalty_clock_effect: unresolvable from a penalty flag alone

observed_game_clock_seconds_remaining.label: observed
observed_game_clock_seconds_remaining.rule: PBP game_seconds_remaining at this play row

actual_game_clock_delta_s.label: inferred
actual_game_clock_delta_s.rule: R4 inferred: current PBP game_seconds_remaining minus next same-quarter PBP play stamp

actual_clock_runoff_s.label: inferred
actual_clock_runoff_s.rule: R4 inferred: current PBP game_seconds_remaining minus next same-quarter PBP play stamp

actual_runoff_behavior.label: inferred
actual_runoff_behavior.rule: derived from the two observed PBP game-clock stamps

in_play_duration_s.rule: PBP-only source has no terminal timestamp or live-play duration
